response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial project work via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in commercial routing or navigation systems, and his resume emphasizes JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang over the required C++/Rust core, raising concerns about his ability to immediately contribute to the routing tile pipeline.
strengths: Built open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world usage
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and learn new languages
Strong background in distributed systems, CI/CD, and low-latency systems
concerns: No demonstrated commercial experience with C++ or Rust in navigation/routing contexts
Primary technical focus is JavaScript/TypeScript/DLang, not the required C++ core
Limited evidence of fault-tolerant distributed systems or map tile optimization at scale
